summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package declares itself as a babel-preset-react wrapper (index.js is 12 lines), but package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods the binary +x, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation via a `WV8StW` shift routine, hex-encoded identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` marker) that is not referenced from the package's own index.js and executes only under the downloaded Bun runtime. The alternate-runtime pattern bypasses Node-based supply-chain tooling, and the obfuscated payload runs automatically on every `npm install` — an arbitrary-code-execution vector on the installer's host that has no relationship to the advertised babel preset functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
